LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_SkillXpDesc: Per skill: Global total XP × Skill multiplier. All skills use the shared stage distribution; 1.00x is neutral. Preview is shown even while the switch is OFF.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_SkillXpRange: Allowed: 0.01x – 100.00x | Unlisted mod skills default to 1.00x.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_TrainerDesc: Multiplies the base XP granted by skill neurotrainers. Passion and other vanilla skilltrainer behavior remain unchanged.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_TrainerSkillDesc: Trainer payout = item's XP × global trainer multiplier × per-skill trainer multiplier. This does NOT change XP required for levels. 1.00x is neutral. Values are retained when disabled.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_TrainerSkillRange: Allowed: 0.01x – 100.00x | Preview uses vanilla 50,000 base XP and excludes passion. Unlisted skills default to 1.00x.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookOffNotice: OFF: vanilla reading XP. Saved Book XP settings are retained.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookDesc: Edit ratios or custom XP/hour directly. Book level caps, passion, learning rate and daily saturation remain unchanged.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookIntEnable: Customize passive Intellectual XP from all books
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookIntBase: Vanilla base input: 250 XP/hour (0.1 XP/tick). Before passion and learning rate.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookQualityDesc: Vanilla XP/hour is per single taught skill. Edits affect only the quality ratio (0–20x); saved ratios remain editable while this section is OFF.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookSkillEnable: Customize XP for each of the 12 vanilla skills
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookSkillDesc: Vanilla 250 XP/hour = Normal quality, one taught skill. This table edits only the skill ratio; the quality ratio applies separately in game. Reading speed, room bonus and LearnRateFactor also apply. Two-skill books give 62.5% per skill.
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookSkillReset: Reset all per-skill book ratios to 1.00x
LanguageData.XPC_L3B3_BookAllReset: Restore Book XP to Vanilla (all three sections)
